spaceAndOwnership.target: Support top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right. Panel is an overlay in screen space; it does not inherit viewport scale.
spaceAndOwnership.keyboardFocus: Keep caller content and native focus order; no focus trap or implicit focus transfer.

spaceAndOwnership.target: Anchor to measured node bounds; expose all cardinal and corner positions plus start/center/end alignment. Offset is CSS screen pixels.

spaceAndOwnership.scale: Toolbar remains screen-sized while following pan/zoom and node movement.

spaceAndOwnership.target: Render caller children inside the transformed graph viewport in graph coordinates. Keep this separate from screen-space Panel, Controls, MiniMap, and toolbars.

Constrain resulting fit zoom to the requested limits.

Forward easing callback only where the public host API accepts it; callback remains caller-owned.

miniMap.target: Accept constant values or callbacks over the public node snapshot; never read internal host Maps.
Style each node rectangle in minimap coordinates.

Allow caller SVG node rendering with the node contract fields id, x, y, width, height, borderRadius, className, color, shapeRendering, strokeColor, strokeWidth, style, selected, and onClick. Host callbacks and SVG attribute types remain framework-native.
Render the viewport mask and its outline.
Use the six screen-space panel positions.
Report minimap graph coordinates or the clicked public node; navigation behavior remains explicitly controlled by pannable/zoomable.

Invert drag direction, set scroll zoom step, and pad/offset viewport bounds in minimap scale.
Expose SVG attributes and class/style; reserve click handler semantics for minimap coordinate callbacks.
Include measured nested nodes and omit hidden nodes; update with accepted graph changes and viewport changes. Fallback measurement assumptions must be documented.

Support every Position value, Align start/center/end, and pixel offset.

Enforce limits through public resize/edit operations.
Constrain resize deltas to maintain initial aspect ratio.
Keep handles/lines screen-sized as viewport zoom changes when enabled; graph-scaled when disabled.
Allow caller to veto each resize before committing.
Report the lifecycle with public node identity and resulting dimensions; callbacks are host-native.
